name: Live Weather Hazards & Monsoon Flood Warnings Along Route
problem: Travelers driving highway corridors in Western Ghats, Himachal, and coastal highways encounter sudden torrential downpours, waterlogging, or ghat landslides without advance route notification.
evidence_source: Itinerary navigation drop-offs during monsoon months; Pelias geocoding queries for mountain passes (Ooty, Munnar, Coorg).
why_now: High highway corridor travel volume; Open-Meteo & IMD radar APIs provide free, high-accuracy polygon forecast endpoints.
expected_value: Prevents stranded road trips; enhances driver safety and user retention.

cross_platform_impact.web: Weather warning badge and route elevation hazard banner on web itinerary preview.
cross_platform_impact.android: Push notification and turn-by-turn banner when route intersects active rain polygon.
cross_platform_impact.ios: Live Activity / Dynamic Island weather alerts during active navigation.
cross_platform_impact.backend: New Express corridor weather aggregator service with 15-min in-memory caching.
cross_platform_impact.database: Cached weather alert polygon table in Supabase PostgreSQL.
cross_platform_impact.ai: Gemini prompt modifier suggesting earlier departure time or scenic bypass.
cross_platform_impact.maps: Mapbox weather polygon fill layer rendered over Mapbox GL polyline.
cross_platform_impact.navigation: OSRM detour calculation if highway is flagged blocked.
cross_platform_impact.security: Zero location logging; coordinates processed transiently.

council_review.recommendation: Ready for Product Owner decision. High ROI and strategic alignment.
risks: Third-party API rate limits mitigated via in-memory caching.

name: Smart EV Charging & Fuel Optimization Along Highway Corridor
problem: EV travelers suffer from range anxiety; current route planning does not account for battery consumption across steep elevations (ghats) or fast-charger availability.
evidence_source: User inquiries on EV charging stops; EV sales increased 42% YoY in India.
why_now: National charging infrastructure expansion (Statiq, Tata Power, Zeon); API integrations now accessible.
expected_value: Positions VoyPlan as the definitive EV road-trip platform in India.

cross_platform_impact.web: Vehicle battery capacity setup in trip creation modal.
cross_platform_impact.android: Android Auto / Car App charging stop waypoint suggestions.
cross_platform_impact.backend: Vehicle consumption calculator based on elevation profile (SRTM elevation data).
cross_platform_impact.api: POST /api/vehicle/ev-plan with battery % and vehicle model.
cross_platform_impact.database: Verified Indian EV fast-charging stations table with connector types (CCS2, Type 2).
cross_platform_impact.ai: Gemini recommendation engine suggesting meal breaks during 45-min fast charging.
cross_platform_impact.maps: Mapbox charging pin clusters with real-time connector availability.
cross_platform_impact.navigation: Automated waypoint injection if range drops below 18% before next stop.
cross_platform_impact.security: User vehicle profile stored securely under Supabase user RLS.

council_review.recommendation: Ready for Product Owner decision. High ROI and strategic alignment.
risks: Third-party API rate limits mitigated via in-memory caching.

name: Real-Time Collaborative Trip Planning with Live Presence
problem: Groups planning family vacations or friends' road trips must share screenshots or chat back and forth; no single shared canvas exists in VoyPlan.
evidence_source: Over 68% of travel itineraries created are multi-passenger group trips.
why_now: VoyPlan already runs a robust WebSocket server in `backend/src/index.js` ready for room-based sync.
expected_value: Drives viral network effects as trip creators invite family and friends to join their trip.

cross_platform_impact.web: Live cursor presence and shared stop reordering via WebSockets.
cross_platform_impact.android: Instant push notification when an invited friend adds a stop.
cross_platform_impact.ios: Real-time sync via WebSocket channel with optimistic local update.
cross_platform_impact.backend: WebSocket room broadcasting under /ws/trips/:tripId in Express.
cross_platform_impact.database: Supabase trip_collaborators table with roles: OWNER, EDITOR, VIEWER.
cross_platform_impact.ai: AI consensus mediator suggesting compromise activities when travelers disagree.
cross_platform_impact.maps: Multi-colored pins representing stops proposed by different group members.
cross_platform_impact.navigation: Single finalized master route generated upon owner lock.
cross_platform_impact.security: Token-based room authorization; private trip data protected by RLS.

council_review.recommendation: Ready for Product Owner decision. High ROI and strategic alignment.
risks: Third-party API rate limits mitigated via in-memory caching.

name: Offline Route & Waypoint Export to GPX, KML & PDF Guide
problem: Travelers venturing into zero-connectivity mountain valleys (Ladakh, Spiti, Nilgiris) lose web/mobile access if cellular networks fail.
evidence_source: Support queries regarding offline maps and zero-coverage route reliability.
why_now: Standard XML formats (GPX 1.1, KML) are zero-dependency and high-reliability.
expected_value: Guarantees safety in remote areas; printable PDF serves elderly pilgrimage travelers.

cross_platform_impact.web: Export Modal with 1-click Download GPX / KML / Printable PDF.
cross_platform_impact.android: Share intent allowing GPX export directly to Garmin, OsmAnd, or Google Earth.
cross_platform_impact.ios: Share sheet export to Apple Maps / GPX viewers.
cross_platform_impact.backend: Export service in Node.js converting JSON route geometry into standard XML.
cross_platform_impact.database: No schema change required; generates dynamically from trip_stops.
cross_platform_impact.ai: Gemini summarization creating a 1-page printable emergency contact & stop overview.
cross_platform_impact.maps: Exports complete encoded OSRM polyline track points.
cross_platform_impact.navigation: 100% offline navigation capability in any standalone GPS hardware.
cross_platform_impact.security: Export requires valid JWT authentication of trip owner or collaborator.

council_review.recommendation: Ready for Product Owner decision. High ROI and strategic alignment.
risks: Third-party API rate limits mitigated via in-memory caching.

rejection_reason: Focusing exclusively on connected vehicle corridors this quarter.

title: Smart EV Charging & Fuel Optimization Along Highway Corridor
description: Automatically calculate vehicle battery/fuel consumption along route and schedule optimal charging/refueling stops based on vehicle efficiency and station ratings.
frontend_impact: mobile/lib/screens/itinerary_screen.dart (Add fuel/charging stop badge & refill estimate)
backend_impact: backend/src/routes/vehicle.js (New vehicle profile & fuel cost endpoints)
acceptance_criteria: Route calculation calculates range based on vehicle efficiency
Warns user if leg exceeds remaining range before next verified station
Injects charging/refueling stops with minimum detours (<3 km from highway)

title: Live Weather Hazards & Monsoon Flood Alerts on Active Route
description: Cross-reference weather forecasts with planned route waypoints to alert travelers about heavy rainfall, fog, or mountain road landslides.
frontend_impact: mobile/lib/screens/navigation_screen.dart (Weather warning banner along route polyline)
acceptance_criteria: Queries weather for origin, destination, and key midway pass waypoints
Flags alert if precipitation > 20mm/hr or visibility < 200m

title: Offline Route Export to GPX / KML & Printable PDF Itinerary
description: Allow travelers venturing into remote areas with weak cellular reception (e.g. Western Ghats, Ladakh, Ooty) to export complete route geometry and offline waypoint guides.
acceptance_criteria: Generated GPX file contains standard <trkpt> points conforming to GPX 1.1
Waypoints contain place names, arrival times, and stop duration descriptions
